lede: Jacksonville Jaguars carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#3 in EPA per play) and the better defensive rating with it, so the ratings point the same way on both sides of the ball.
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Baltimore Ravens +0.5 with a fair total of 48.0 — approximately a one-score game, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Jacksonville Jaguars pass offence vs Baltimore Ravens pass defence, which sits +0.246 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.

The largest uncertainty is quarterback information: Jacksonville Jaguars and Baltimore Ravens have no confirmed starter on file, which materially affects how much confidence the exact number deserves.
